policy_basis: Google Play User Data and Data safety requirements; final declaration must match the exact release artifact and integrated SDKs/services

current_application_behavior.internet_permission_purpose: Google Play Billing and HTTPS purchase-token verification only; gameplay remains offline-first

allowlisted_runtime_data_integrations.purpose: HTTPS purchase-token verification for Google Play Billing entitlements
HTTP method enum used by the same HTTPS purchase-verification client

production_purchase_verification.architecture: app sends the minimum purchase verification envelope over HTTPS to a developer backend; backend verifies ProductPurchaseV2 with Google Play and confirms acknowledgement before authoritative entitlement grant
production_purchase_verification.transport: HTTPS POST JSON; no-store; concurrent request isolation; exact verification_request_id correlation

backend_authentication.client_to_backend: public HTTPS without reusable client secret
backend_authentication.backend_to_google: attached service account via Application Default Credentials

data_safety_candidate.reason: 12.4 backend is implemented but not deployed/frozen; final Data Safety answers must cover the exact AAB, production endpoint, final retention/deletion policy and Play Console configuration
data_safety_candidate.payment_service_financial_data: Google Play may collect payment information directly under its own terms; the app must not claim developer collection when the app never accesses that payment information
data_safety_candidate.purchase_history_or_purchase_token: purchase token is transiently transmitted to the developer verification backend and Google Play; the reference backend persists a SHA-256 token hash and minimal purchase/entitlement state, not the raw token or order id; final Play declaration remains pending production freeze

must_cover: data accessed, collected, used and shared
Google Play purchase-token verification and backend handling
raw purchase-token transient processing versus hashed server record

release_requirements: deploy and certify 12.4 billing backend, then repeat technical data-flow audit
freeze production HTTPS verification endpoint, attached service identity, rate limiting and backend retention/deletion behavior
prove production persistence does not retain raw purchase tokens or order ids outside the declared contract
inspect final Android manifest and merged permissions from the release AAB
inventory every third-party SDK/service in the final artifact and production architecture
confirm the only application runtime network path beyond Google Play Billing is the allowlisted purchase-verification client
publish privacy policy on a stable public URL and expose the final version in-app
finalize product/legal_documents.json from pre_release to final and synchronize its public URLs
complete Play Console Data Safety form from the frozen release behavior
ensure store declaration, runtime legal surface, backend behavior and privacy policy remain consistent
pass privacy_data_safety_gate.py --release and legal_surface_gate.py --release on the final release ancestry
record final Data Safety answers in this repository
